name: analytics-cpu-layout-fit
goal: Keep CPU readings visible and readable at every viewport.

evidence: Mobile hides CPU table columns; tablet breaks measured. All readings and words must remain visible.
The catalog checked CPU values but not column bounds or word wrapping; it now asserts both layouts.
Regression b2574e4e8cef reproduced the tablet word break and mobile table overflow on harbor-mbp-2.
Use compact CPU table cells on mobile and the existing quiet style for unmeasured totals.
The unchanged tablet and mobile catalog regression passed on harbor-mbp-2.
